title: TLS cert expiry warning uses file mtime not X.509 notAfter field
description: Trigger: operator replaces kith-cert.der with a cert from an external CA that expires in 90 days. File mtime is 'now', so the heuristic thinks the cert has ~365 days remaining and emits a normal info log. The real expiry in 90 days is invisible. Consequence: operator gets no warning until the cert silently expires. tls.rs lines 62-91. A real fix parses the DER cert with rcgen/x509-parser to read the actual notAfter field.
